posts.title: Ivan Nedyalkov
posts.author: Ivan Nedyalkov
posts.authorInfo: Indie Developer and designer living in Varna, Bulgaria
posts.intro: By day, Ivan Nedyalkov is an Operations Product Manager at a large online retail company. On the side, he is an indie developer and designer. He's currently working on Velosity, an iOS app for space enthusiasts that provides detailed tracking of ongoing and upcoming space launch operations.

qa.usefulItem: It's got to be the Logitech MX Master 3 mouse. I've been using it for both work and personal stuff for about 2 years now. It sure needs an upgrade.
qa.inspiration: By looking around and noticing things that annoy me or don't work well, whether it's something as basic as keyboard shortcuts or poorly designed notifications. Each frustrating thing I see becomes motivation for me to come up with a better solution or fix or improve it. The most inspiring things catch my attention—their quality and user experience push me to explore new ideas and designs. Actually, my job is my biggest source of inspiration because it exposes me to a wide range of problems and challenges that keep me thinking creatively.
qa.biggestChallenge: While the app's development has been smooth, scaling it to serve a growing user base has been a significant challenge for me. Making sure the backend infrastructure can handle increased demand has required careful planning, setting up servers to handle more traffic, and optimizing database queries.
